description: มุน 2026-08-03 (ฟีม): the 5 wuxing element chips on the ดวงสมพงศ์ result. TWO bug-classes. (1) UNVERIFIABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION STATE-SPACE — the screen renders only TWO chips at a time (the pair being compared), so ANY single render can see at most 2 of 5 elements; a spot-check is structurally incapable of covering the palette. >60% of real users are not a น้ำ-ดิน pair, i.e. most users see colours no test had ever rendered. The anchor now ENUMERATES all five by driving three different element pairs through the real route and asserting each glyph colour, then asserts the set of elements seen == 5 (so dropping a pair from the sweep fails loudly instead of silently shrinking coverage). (2) TILE-TINT DRIFT — the tile background is NOT a free choice: measuring the only two Figma-sampled chips (น้ำ #4C8CE6/#E2ECFB, ดิน #CC9E4C/#F7EFE2) showed the tile is the GLYPH colour composited over WHITE at 16.2%, true on all 6 channels (0.157-0.165), and re-deriving from the rule reproduces both sampled tiles EXACTLY. So a hand-picked tile that merely 'looks about right' is a defect. elementTint() encodes the rule, the map derives every tile from its glyph, and the anchor asserts the relation per element (±2/255 for rounding). PROVENANCE, kept honest: น้ำ + ดิน glyphs are Figma-sampled (636:22150); ไม้ #4CBD32 / ไฟ #D94C4C / ทอง #D9B84C are ฟีม-ruled 2026-08-03 because NO node in the file draws them — searched and documented: search_design_system returns empty, the chip binds no variable (get_variable_defs = {}), the chip is a plain frame not an instance (no variants), and the 'ธาตุของคุณ' screen 300-2356 uses a different small-icon treatment. Chosen from a rendered 5-step comparison sheet (ฟีม picked the tuned family, then asked for ไม้ a step darker) — decided from pixels, not from a hex guess. Teeth-proven live (run-compat-zones.ts, 42/42): mut-element-tint-drift (a tile hand-edited off the rule) → CAUGHT. gate_layer=visual (computed style + enumerated state-space). Existing anchors re-run green (3c/2e2/sprites/zones). Did NOT touch pages/matching or constants/api/api-user-matching (git diff 0). ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-compat-zones.ts#mut-element-tint-drift
